name: leapmotor-car-expert-workbuddy
description: Answers Leapmotor questions on models, trims, version differences and buying costs using dated, traceable public sources, including on-road cost with purchase tax and budget-constrained shortlists.

displayDescription.zh: 查零跑车型与配置，比较年款版本差异，按预算和补能条件整理候选，估算含购置税的落地成本并附来源。
displayDescription.en: Research Leapmotor trims, compare versions, shortlist by budget and charging needs, and estimate on-road cost with traceable sources.

quickPrompts.zh: 按我的预算和充电条件，比较合适的零跑车型。
quickPrompts.en: Compare Leapmotor models for my budget and charging needs.

quickPrompts.zh: 核对这两个年款和配置有什么关键差异。
quickPrompts.en: Check the key differences between these model years and trims.

quickPrompts.zh: 这项功能是全系标配还是选装？请给出来源。
quickPrompts.en: Is this feature standard or optional? Please cite sources.
